hook: Chip loopholes, a data unicorn, saturated tests, SEBI's AI rules
summary: Chinese firms reportedly rented Nvidia AI computing power in Southeast Asia, slipping past US sanctions.
Databento raised $100M at a $1.1B valuation, and Ethan Mollick's SatBench finds 63% of 173 lab-cited benchmarks saturated.
Mollick also says research agent swarms will bring heavy web traffic, while SEBI prepares AI rules for India's markets.

stories.headline: Nvidia chips accessed by Chinese companies in SE Asia data centers
stories.summary: Massive data centers in Southeast Asia exploited a gap in U.S. sanctions to provide computing power for Chinese companies using Nvidia AI chips. This backdoor route built a multibillion-dollar business that kept Beijing in the AI race.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how export controls can be bypassed through overseas data center networks, affecting regulatory strategies for AI hardware.
source_titles: How Jensen Huang built a multibillion-dollar business to let Chinese companies access Nvidia AI chips in SE Asian data centers, exploiting a gap in US sanctions (Wall Street Journal)
How Jensen Huang Built the Backdoor Route That Keeps Beijing in the AI Race
stories.line: Chinese firms tapped Nvidia AI power via Southeast Asian data centers
stories.detail: Overseas hosts slipped through a sanctions loophole and built a multibillion-dollar business
stories.image_prompt: A vast, dimly lit data center hall with rows of glowing server racks and cooling pipes, viewed down a long aisle at night.
stories.anchor: We begin in Southeast Asia. The Journal reports Chinese firms rented Nvidia computing power there. The lesson? Export controls can be routed around.

stories.headline: Databento raises $100M Series C at $1.1B valuation
stories.summary: Market data platform Databento raised a $100 million Series C round at a $1.1 billion valuation, led by Fifth Down Capital. The company reports it has doubled its revenue since its Series B round and holds enterprise contracts with five of the six largest frontier AI labs.
stories.why_it_matters: The funding highlights the growing demand for programmatic, cloud-delivered market data from both traditional financial institutions and frontier AI labs.
source_titles: Databento, which offers market data APIs and says it has contracts with five of the six largest frontier AI labs, raised a $100M Series C at a $1.1B valuation (FinTech Global)
Databento: $100 Million Series C Values Market Data Company At $1.1 Billion

stories.anchor: Turning to money. Databento sells market data to five of the six biggest AI labs, it says. Investors are backing that demand.

stories.headline: Ethan Mollick creates SatBench to track AI benchmark saturation
stories.summary: Ethan Mollick created SatBench to measure how quickly major AI benchmarks become saturated by AI, finding that 63% of 173 benchmarks cited by labs since 2023 are now saturated.
stories.why_it_matters: It highlights that AI models are improving at a pace that outruns traditional methods of measurement.
source_titles: Ethan Mollick: AI is getting better faster than our measurements are. I threw together SatBench, which measures how quickly major AI benchmarks become…
stories.line: SatBench finds most AI benchmarks are already saturated
stories.detail: Ethan Mollick's tracker: 63% of 173 benchmarks cited by labs since 2023 are now maxed out
stories.image_prompt: A row of analog gauges and dials with needles pinned at the maximum, on a clean laboratory bench under bright light.
stories.anchor: Also tonight, a measuring problem. The tests can't keep up. Models are improving faster than the yardsticks.

stories.headline: Ethan Mollick on agent swarm research traffic and Fable 5.2
stories.summary: Ethan Mollick reported that agent swarms conducting research generate large volumes of traffic and use repeated full-text searches to find information. He used Claude Fable 5.2 to reconstruct W.H. Auden's 1941 poetry class by having it read an obscure book from the Internet Archive line by line.
stories.why_it_matters: It highlights the practical capabilities of AI agent swarms in performing complex, multi-step research tasks and the resulting impact on web traffic.
source_titles: Ethan Mollick: The traffic from agent swarms doing research is going to be quite large, they are relentless at finding info. I had Fable 5.2 reconstruct…
stories.line: Mollick: research agent swarms will drive heavy web traffic
stories.detail: He had Claude Fable 5.2 rebuild W.H. Auden's 1941 poetry class from an obscure archived book
stories.image_prompt: Bundles of fiber-optic network cables glowing with pulses of light, flowing into a switch panel in a server room.
stories.anchor: Meanwhile, the same researcher says AI agents search relentlessly. That means far more traffic for the web.

stories.lab: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
stories.headline: Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets focusing on investor protection
stories.summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that the regulator will soon release detailed guidelines governing AI use in securities markets, emphasizing disclosures, accountability and a human‑in‑the‑loop approach to protect investors.
stories.why_it_matters: The rules aim to safeguard market integrity and investor interests as AI tools become more prevalent in trading and analysis.
